## Task 2 — Run a small real BOPTEST smoke test
Create a separately identified, disposable **live-dashboard smoke-test session**, not a new energy-performance experiment.
Perform the minimum simulation advances needed to show actual data flowing from BOPTEST into the dashboard.
Do not consume, alter, or reuse G299's frozen experiment slots.
Do not force a 24.5°C action under unsuitable conditions merely to produce an impressive demonstration.
